g.title: 📌 Farm Fund low-interest secured loan fund — The Co-op set up a low-interest secured loan fund for farm infrastructure in partnership with Industrial Credit Union and the Whatcom Community Foundation. Source: communityfood.coop Farm Fund history. kind: Money — grant or loan fund direction: two-way

text.tspan: Farm Fund low-interest secured loan fund

g.title: 📌 Farm Fund grant — co-op development for farmworkers — Listed in the Farm Fund's earlier projects: funded Community to Community's work "on cooperative development for farm workers and Latino consumer access to local food". Year not given. kind: Money — grant or loan fund

📌 Organised and incubated the co-op; led the land fundraising — C2C organised Washington's first farmworker-owned co-op farm and raised grants, public funds and private donations to buy the 65 acres; the land is meant to pass to a land trust. Source: PCC Sound Consumer, June 2023. kind: Built or helped build the co-op
📌 Supplies produce — The Bellingham food co-op is among Tierra y Libertad's buyers. Source: PCC Sound Consumer, June 2023. kind: Trade — supplies goods

📌 Supplies grass-fed beef — The Co-op stocks North Cascade Meats beef (Barrau Farms, Whatcom; Forest Cattle Co., Skagit). The Co-op's general manager and meat manager took part in launching the meat co-op, and the Farm Fund paid for a Matheson Farms field day (2016–19) that covered "benefits of the cooperative model" — Matheson is a founding board farm. kind: Trade — supplies goods

📌 Network of co-ops in Whatcom and Skagit counties, began 2014 as the Co-op Education Project, renamed 2019, incorporated as a secondary co-op in January 2022. No fixed office — pin is downtown Bellingham. cascadecooperatives.coop · (360) 441-2728. g.title: 📌 1240 Central Rd, Everson. Washington's first farmworker-owned co-op farm, launched 2017 on 65 acres. Berries, squash, nopales. $55,000 from the Community Food Sovereignty Fund (Food Lifeline) for a greenhouse; PCC Food Access Grant. g.title: 📌 Downtown store 1220 N Forest St; Cordata store 315 Westerly Rd. Founded 1970 in Fairhaven.
